info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Design Management API
info.description: The Product Design Management API enables businesses to modify existing product design specifications within your banking platform. This endpoint allows authorized users to update critical attributes of a product design, ensuring alignment with market needs and compliance requirements. Typical consumers include product managers and design teams aiming to enhance product offerings or rectify design issues. Leverage this API to maintain up-to-date product designs that support operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific product design identified by its unique ID. Ensure to provide the required information in the request body for the update to be successful.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific product design identified by the unique ID 'PROD-700045'. Please ensure that all necessary fields are included in the request to successfully modify the product information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, product details updated.
